description_en: Queries the information about a file resource
description_zh: 获取指定文件资源的详细信息
name: GetResource

parameters.help_en:
The DataWorks workspace ID. You can log on to the DataWorks console (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console) and go to the Workspace page to query the ID.

You must configure this parameter to specify the DataWorks workspace to which the API operation is applied
parameters.help_zh:
DataWorks工作空间的ID。您可以登录DataWorks控制台 (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)，进入工作空间管理页面获取ID。

该参数用来确定本次API调用操作使用的DataWorks工作空间
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en:
The unique identifier of the file resource.

This field is of type Long in SDK versions prior to 8.0.0, and of type String in SDK version 8.0.0 and later. This change does not affect the normal use of the SDK; parameters are still returned according to the type defined in the SDK. Compilation failures due to the type change may occur only when upgrading the SDK across version 8.0.0, in which case users need to manually correct the data type
parameters.help_zh:
文件资源的唯一标识符。

<notice>该字段在SDK8.0.0版本之前为Long类型，SDK8.0.0版本及之后为String类型。该变更不影响SDK正常使用，参数仍会按SDK中定义的类型返回。只有在跨8.0.0版本的SDK升级时，类型变更可能会导致项目编译不通过，需要用户手动修正数据类型。></notice>
parameters.name: id

RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID。用于出现错误后排查问题

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the file resource was created. This value is a UNIX timestamp

Id.description_en:
The unique identifier of the file resource.

Prior to SDK version 8.0.0, this field is of type Long. In SDK version 8.0.0 and later, it is of type String. This change does not affect the normal use of the SDK. The parameter is returned based on the type defined in the SDK. Compilation failures caused by the type change may occur only when you upgrade the SDK across version 8.0.0. In this case, you must manually update the data type
Id.description_zh:
文件资源的唯一标识符。

<notice>该字段在SDK8.0.0版本之前为Long类型，SDK8.0.0版本及之后为String类型。该变更不影响SDK正常使用，参数仍会按SDK中定义的类型返回。只有在跨8.0.0版本的SDK升级时，类型变更可能会导致项目编译不通过，需要用户手动修正数据类型。></notice>

ModifyTime.description_en: The time when the file resource was last modified. This value is a UNIX timestamp
ModifyTime.description_zh:
文件资源最近更新时间

格式为 13 位数字，例如 `1700539206000`

Name.description_en: The name of the file resource

Owner.description_en: The owner of the file resource

ProjectId.description_en: The ID of the workspace to which the file resource belongs
ProjectId.description_zh: 文件资源所在工作空间的ID

Spec.description_en: The FlowSpec field information about the file resource. For more information, see FlowSpec (https://github.com/aliyun/alibabacloud-dataworks-tool-dflow)
Spec.description_zh: 描述这个文件资源的FlowSpec信息，具体规范详见FlowSpec (https://github.com/aliyun/alibabacloud-dataworks-tool-dflow)
